name: Man-O-War Marina
brand_truth: The only fuel on Man-O-War Cay and a full-service marina since 1976, rebuilt after Dorian: 23 slips to 120 ft with 7 ft at low tide.
buyer: US East Coast and Florida cruising owners and captains crossing to Abaco, on a phone

direction.why: A small full-service marina reads best as a quiet, well-made print feature; aqua of the flats as one field section; competitors in the repo use ocean arrivals, maps and splits.

big_idea: A harbour broadsheet with a live dateline: under their own sunset dock photo, one sentence in Bahamas time says what is open on the cay now and when the fuel dock next opens.
concept_type: brochure: marina sales site with slip check and slip request
current_site_findings: Listed domain manowarmarina.com shows an unrelated article
Specs buried in a paragraph on Services
pitch_line: Your harbour, with a front page that tells a captain what is open right now and whether his boat fits, before he picks up the radio.
assumptions: Sunday treated as closed (hours published Mon-Sat only)
Dinner service mentioned on services page; hours not published, so not shown
sources: factory/briefs/man-o-war-marina.md (earlier verified FAQ and MOW Life facts)
